decisions.reason: Batteryless USB operation does not alter the required current capacity of the existing VBUS and battery copper paths.
This Requirement covers a separate LDO used when the modular main board operates without the AXP2101 power board; AXP2101 batteryless operation does not change it.
The source changes the AXP2101 input power condition but does not change the 5V rail loads, converter, or GPIO control behavior.
Operating from USB without a battery does not change the AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal assembly requirement.
The source does not change which rails must be measured, their monitoring topology, or the unresolved choice of monitoring IC.
Supporting operation without a battery does not remove or modify the electrical interface required when a battery is connected.
The batteryless power-source condition does not alter the configured DCDC1 voltage or its 3.3V regulation target.
The source does not change the panel button connector, PWRON signal connection, or on/off control behavior.
The accepted ESP32 decoupling arrangement is independent of whether the AXP2101 receives power from USB with no battery.
Batteryless operation does not remove the planned battery or change connector placement, board orientation, or antenna keepout constraints.
The ability to operate temporarily without a battery does not entail removing the battery from the device enclosure or changing its mounting requirements.
The AXP2101 input power condition does not affect the ESP32 module selection, full pin breakout, or breakout pitch.
